basic_details.job_title: Bhatkhande University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 14 Accompanist and Tabla Accompanist Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya, Lucknow has invited applications for 14 Accompanist (Sangatkarta) posts in Tabla, Sarangi, and Vocal (Folk Dance) under advertisement number 1568/Bha.Sa.Vivi.-1(1)/2025T.C., dated 22 October 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the Samarth portal at https://bhatkhandeuniversitynt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login until 23 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Application fee is Rs. 500/-, while for Scheduled Caste candidates this fee is fixed at Rs. 300/-, which in no case will be refunded. (Enclose the Demand Draft drawn in favor of "KulSachiv, Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya, Lucknow" while submitting the form.)

age_limit.details: The minimum age for application to direct recruitment for the post of Accompanist is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years. An upper age limit relaxation of 05 years shall be given to candidates of the Scheduled Caste and Other Backward Class categories (maximum age 40 years for Scheduled Caste candidates).

qualification.details: Post Qualification Required Accompanist (Sangatkarta) - All Disciplines Degree / Visharad / Samaksh in the concerned discipline with a minimum of 55 percent marks. For Scheduled Caste candidates, 50 percent marks are valid. Three years of work experience in the concerned field is expected. Proficiency as a graded artist in All India Radio is desired. A demonstration during the interview is necessary.

selection_process: A demonstration at the time of interview is necessary.
how_to_apply: Submit/upload the application through the Samarth portal https://bhatkhandeuniversitynt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login by all candidates.
Enclose the Demand Draft for Rs. 500/- (or Rs. 300/- for Scheduled Caste) issued in favor of "KulSachiv, Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya, Lucknow" along with the application form.
Ensure the application is submitted by the last date of 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: BSV Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fee is Rs. 500/-, while for Scheduled Caste candidates this fee is fixed at Rs. 300/-, which in no case will be refunded. (Enclose the Demand Draft drawn in favor of "KulSachiv, Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya, Lucknow" while submitting the form.)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BSV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit/upload the application through the Samarth portal https://bhatkhandeuniversitynt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login by all candidates. Enclose the Demand Draft for Rs. 500/- (or Rs. 300/- for Scheduled Caste) issued in favor of "KulSachiv, Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya, Lucknow" along with the application form. Ensure the application is submitted by the last date of 23 November 2026.

content_sections.text: A demonstration at the time of interview is necessary.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies are available for Accompanist posts across Tabla, Sarangi, and Vocal (Folk Dance).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for the Accompanist posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree, Visharad, or equivalent qualification in the concerned discipline with at least 55 percent marks (50 percent for Scheduled Caste candidates), along with three years of work experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, an upper age relaxation of 05 years is provided for candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste and Other Backward Class categories (maximum age 40 years for Scheduled Caste candidates).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for general and SC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for general candidates and Rs. 300 for Scheduled Caste candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of KulSachiv, Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the official Samarth portal at https://bhatkhandeuniversitynt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login.

faq.question: Q8. Is a practical demonstration required during selection?
faq.answer: Yes, a demonstration is necessary at the time of the interview.
